derivation: Note 7 PP&E movement discloses opening NBV, depreciation charge for the year, and closing NBV, with an explicit statement that there were no disposals during the year (set to 0). No separate cash-flow statement capex/additions line is provided, so capex must be derived by S4 as closing NBV minus opening NBV plus depreciation minus disposals.
quote:
Net book value at the beginning of the year          $198,135,724.83     [gray bar]

Depreciation charge for the year                     $22,769,549.53      [gray bar]

Net book value at the end of the year                $207,419,710.88    [gray bar]

There were no disposals of property, plant and equipment during the year.
